shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Full cross-level combat, senses, NPC travel, CE bridge, and a subsystem-health panel with per-switch re-arm. LIVE IN OPEN BETA as Workshop 3776015553 (window-3 build); save/load transit fix + panel VERIFIED at commit 11283d9; §43 travel and §44 CE remain the never-run gate before the window-4 upload.

Keep every ⚠.

# As above, So below II (V2)

> V1 is DELETED. 101 .cs files, ~30,000 LOC. No em-dashes anywhere in shipped text.

# 0. START HERE

**CURRENT PHASE: BUILD MODE.** Everything committed and pushed: **`11283d9`** on `v2-spike` (the new publish point when prep resumes). `build_mod` green. `Assemblies/` holds a debug DLL (normal). **Workshop 3776015553 is still on the WINDOW-3 build.**

**⚠⚠ THE REMAINING GATE IS EXACTLY TWO LAUNCHES + THREE COPY ANSWERS.** §43 travel and §44 CE have never executed (the §43 raid check went unanswered across runs 408-410; #409 had CE loaded but no CE result was ever reported). Everything else in the window-4 update is now verified or accepted. **The prep is not the bottleneck; do not re-run it before those launches.**

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: visual clarity from above, performance, vanilla parity.

**⚠⚠ THE FOUR RULES THIS PROJECT PAID THE MOST FOR:**
1. **NOTHING COSMETIC ON DECIDING PATHS** (§33c); **CLAMP AT SELECTION** (§35).
2. **NEVER PATCH `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms`** - use `RegionsRoomsChanged` (§34e) - **AND REPLAY THE ACCIDENTAL WORK WHEN YOU DO (§29c)**.
3. **REGION CONNECTIVITY IS MORE OPTIMISTIC THAN THE PATHFINDER** (§34b): flood CELLS.
4. **COUNT THE EMITTERS AND THE POPULATIONS - AND THE ENGINE STACKS** (§44).

**⚠ NEXT-SESSION QUEUE, in order:** (1) §43 launch (fire RaidEnemy, get the ONE answer: where did they enter) and §44 CE companion launch (`companionMods:["CETeam.CombatExtended"]`); (2) §31b copy answers; (3) redo prep from `11283d9` (or later) → upload → restore; (4) §13.

# 1. ARCHITECTURE
One `Map`, `(w, 1, bandCount*Slot)`; `Slot = ceil((bandHeight+2)/64)*64`; 64-alignment load-bearing.
**The one insight:** `Region.Neighbors` is topological; Portal wormholes conduct connectivity without merging rooms/temp/vacuum; the jobified pathfinder cannot cross a synthetic link → segmented movement.
**⚠⚠ `CanReach` = "with stairs"; pathfinder = "walking now"** (§34, §40).
**⚠⚠ SYNTHETIC LINKS ARE WIPED BY EVERY REGION REBUILD AND ARMED ONLY BY OUR HOOK (§29c):** any rebuild path without a hook firing after it = the whole mod silently off. Load was the known instance (fixed + verified). Open audit: §13.17.
**⚠ THE TOPOLOGICAL TRICK GENERALISES TO NEITHER UTILITIES NOR COMBAT (§41i).**
**⚠ THE GUTTER:** shells (§41f), radial searches (§41i), skyfaller offsets (§41b), spanning shoot lines (§41k), CE round collision (§44), start-spot scatter (§29d).
**⚠ THE VIEW IS DOWNWARD-ONLY; physics, combat rendering, sound and traffic are symmetric.**
**⚠⚠ ANISOTROPY BREAKS EVERY RAW DISTANCE TEST.** `BandOf` CLAMPS.

### ⚠ THE SLICING RULE, ten shapes — anchor/field/noise/extent/aspect/scalar/foreign-writes/radius-vs-gutter/list-sweep/raw-participant-maths. `ABBandLocal.cs` canonical. Unaudited: Basin, Cavern, Chasm, Cliffs, Hollow, Valley.

# 2. LEVEL PLAN — 126/128 (7 cap) · **190/192 (4)** · 254/256 (2); 200 is the number to avoid; plan persists between colonies.

# 3-8a. MOVEMENT, MASS, CAMERA — segmented at `StartPath`; hops strictly decrease; multi-hop ✅. TWO CARRY TRIGGERS (§33c/h). **ONE DESCENT RULE + ONE SANCTIONED SIBLING (`ABShaft.ColumnOpen`).**

# 8b. DEPTH SHRINK — loose contents only; terrain never; no shrink for flecks/relayed things.

# 9. GENERATION COST — FillRock tracks HILLINESS; RAINFALL dominates Plants. **⚠⚠ HILLINESS DECIDES TEST VALIDITY. ⚠ SWAMPY FLAT TILES ARE THE START-SPOT STRESS CASE (§29d).**

# 10-12. PERF AND DIAGNOSTICS
**⚠ BISECT TOGGLES PERSIST. ⚠ Palette strips its LAST entry (pad it). ⚠ OUR REPORTS = warning rows** (the gen profile row `#82ce90ce` appears once per run - it is instrumentation, not an error).
**⚠⚠ A CLEAN LOG IS NOT A WORKING FEATURE; NEITHER IS A ONE-POPULATION PASS; NEITHER IS A LAUNCH THE HUMAN DID NOT REPORT BACK ON. A blanket "tests good" against an EXPLICIT per-run checklist counts for that checklist and nothing beyond it (run #410's precedent: it flipped §29c/§15b/§29b, could not touch §43/§44).**
**⚠⚠ BUILD THE DETECTOR WHEN READING WON'T YIELD. ⚠⚠ A DIAGNOSTIC THAT CAN SILENCE ITSELF IS A TRAP. ⚠⚠ AN INSTRUMENT CAN BE FOOLED BY THE TERM IT HUNTS. ⚠⚠ SILENT FALLBACK BRANCHES MUST LOG THEIR CENSUS (§29d).**
**⚠ CIRCINUS: python, not jq.**

# 14. LESSONS
**Method.** Prove innocence by finding a state where the suspect CANNOT EXIST. One change per experiment. Diagnostic before theory; after five failed theories, SHIP THE INSTRUMENT.
**⚠⚠ COUNT EMITTERS/HOMES/POPULATIONS/DERIVATIONS/SENSES/DIRECTIONS/ENGINE STACKS - AND GAME LIFECYCLES (§29c).**
**⚠⚠ AN EVENT SUBSCRIPTION ONLY SEES CHANGES AFTER IT EXISTS (§29c). ⚠⚠ AN API BUILT FOR A UI IS NOT THE UI (§15b). ⚠⚠ SUPPRESSING A DRAW IS SAFE; SUPPRESSING A BAKE IS NOT (§29b). ⚠⚠ A SKIPPED `Regenerate` IS STILL MARKED CLEAN (§29b). ⚠⚠ A MUTABLE GLOBAL IN A SKIP CONDITION IS A PROMISE TO DIRTY ON EVERY TRANSITION (§29b). ⚠⚠ MECHANICAL PREP IS NOT PROGRESS WHEN THE BLOCKER IS EDITORIAL. ⚠⚠ A REMAP CAN NEUTRALIZE YOUR OWN DOWNSTREAM HOOK (§44). ⚠⚠ FALLBACKS THAT DECIDE SILENTLY GET DIAGNOSED BACKWARDS (§29d).**
**⚠⚠ SURFACE-ONLY-BY-ACCIDENT IS NOT A RULE (§43). ⚠⚠ SECOND ENTRY POINTS, NOT FACTION CHECKS (§41i). ⚠⚠ HELPERS REIMPLEMENTING RANGE/BEARING/ANCHOR MATHS ARE INVISIBLE TO VERB PATCHES. ⚠⚠ "DECLINE TO HELP" IS NOT "DENY" (§41c). ⚠⚠ MOVEMENT SYMPTOMS CAN BE RANGE CHECKS. ⚠⚠ THE MISS PATHS ARE A SECOND FEATURE. ⚠⚠ ONE-PAWN-TYPE REPORTS AREN'T TYPE-SPECIFIC. ⚠⚠ DERIVED ANSWERS CAN'T BEAT SOURCES. ⚠⚠ BLIND INSTRUMENTS. ⚠⚠ TELEPORT EXITS RE-DISPATCH. ⚠⚠ thingIDNumber STATICS. ⚠⚠ ONE GESTURE, THREE PATHS. ⚠⚠ REVERT-FIRST. ⚠⚠ CHECK WHETHER IT'S ALREADY BUILT (§29d; §15b).**
**⚠ THE USER'S EYE BEATS THE AGENT'S ARITHMETIC - A PLAYER'S CODE REVIEW BEATS BOTH - A PLAYER'S SAVE FILE BEATS ALL THREE. ⚠ VERIFY "FALSE POSITIVES" AGAINST THE SOURCE. ⚠ INVESTIGATE COUNT DISCREPANCIES. ⚠ FALSE COMMENTS OUTLIVE THEIR TRUTH WINDOW (n=2 in one day, both directions). ⚠ FLAVOR NEVER BREAKS AN INCIDENT. ⚠ PARTICIPATION BY ALLOWLIST. ⚠ A SHADOW CAN BE DRAWN WHERE NOBODY LOOKS. ⚠ HONESTY RULES CAN BE REPLACED BY MORE HONEST RULES. ⚠ EXACT-MATCH KEYS MISS ON EVERY MISS. ⚠ FOUR CASES, ONE DEFECT. ⚠ IMPOSSIBLE FEATURES MAY BE FREE. ⚠ GUARDS ARE PER-CONSUMER. ⚠ COUNT CONSUMERS. ⚠ A ROUNDING-ERROR OPTIMISATION IS NOT WORTH A CORRECTNESS HAZARD. ⚠ FUNNEL BRANCHES LIE UNEQUALLY. ⚠ COPY GOES STALE; NEVER UPDATE AHEAD OF VERIFICATION NOR AHEAD OF THE SHIPPED BUILD (§31c). ⚠ RECORD FALSE POSITIVES. ⚠ DOCUMENTED ROUNDING ERRORS CAN BEAT FRAGILE FIXES.** *(One-liner archive unchanged.)*
**Patching.** Wrap DATA; patch PRODUCERS; INNER METHODS over wrappers; no foreign types in patch signatures; prefix releases in FINALIZERS; `[ThreadStatic]` latches; RE-ENTER WITH CORRECTED INPUTS; REIMPLEMENT WHEN GUARDS SIT AHEAD; POSTFIX-CORRECT COSMETICS; BOX/SETVALUE/UNBOX structs; REBUILD IMMUTABLE-ANCHOR STRUCTS; gate LIFETIME or OBSERVER; SUPPRESS AT `Visible`, NEVER AT `Regenerate`; EVENT SUBSCRIPTIONS NEED AN INITIAL REPLAY.
**Engine facts.** *(archive unchanged.)* `Map.FinalizeInit` order: RebuildAllRegionsAndRooms → components LAST. Radial searches return the cell NEAREST THE SEED. `Widgets.CheckboxDraw` = read-only tick, no font risk.
**⚠⚠ CE FACTS (§44): unchanged. ⚠⚠ block archive: unchanged.**
